zh-CN.title: 链接与发言卡片更稳定
items: 所有链接都会以统一尺寸的卡片展示，解析中或解析失败也不会造成页面跳动
聊天中的发言会按文字、语音、视频和图片数量提前预留稳定空间

en.title: Stable link and post cards
items: Every link now uses a consistently sized card, including pending and failed previews
Shared posts now reserve stable space based on text, audio, video, and image count
